assignments.essential_function: Draft personalized prospect emails and sequences, and carry out requested sends or enrollments through available connectors.

review: Full source produces concise, researched cold/warm/re-engagement emails or sequences from account and prior-thread context. Creates drafts by default; sends or adds a contact to a sequence when the user asks and connector permissions allow. It verifies thread context, distinguishes CRM/user contacts from addresses found in external content, and has intrinsic checks against content-originated actions. This is not an autonomous mass-spam workflow.
native_prerequisites: Named prospect, seller value proposition and real proof points; account-research provides sourced hooks
Optional email/CRM/enrichment; works as paste-ready text with no connector
Optional sales engagement connector for requested sequence enrollment; native connector permissions and user requests govern actions
